results.title: Vindicta
results.overview: In just one moment 19-year-old Hannah's world shatters when her parents are murdered in front of her. After fleeing, she seeks refuge with family friends before becoming the embodiment of rage and revenge towards those responsible for destroying her life. An unexpected connection with a handsome young Nazi Officer generates a moment of respite, but she is consumed by vengeance at any cost, no matter what or when. The story is inspired by the true events of women who helped defeat the Nazis during WWII.

results.title: ZsaZsa Zaturnnah vs The Amazonistas of Planet X
results.original_title: ZsaZsa Zaturnnah vs The Amazonistas of Planet X
results.overview: Ada is a shy gay man living in a small town in the Philippines. After many heartbreaks over many years, he has committed himself to a simple and single life. But when a magical stone from outer space transforms him into a flamboyant female superhero, Ada is forced to face fantastic challenges. From fighting zombies to stopping invading Amazonistas from Planet X, to the even more difficult task of risking his heart to love again.

results.title: De Tatta's: Daan
results.overview: Daan wants to impress his crush, Layla. He promises to come up with the most epic gift ever for her birthday party. What seems simple turns into a chaotic quest, filled with bizarre situations and unexpected encounters.

results.title: Voices Inside Your Head
results.overview: Diverse individuals (a demolition expert, a visagist, a physicist, an Indigenous leader, and a Santo Daime priest) recount how psychedelics transformed their lives in unexpected and profound ways.

results.title: Deadly
results.overview: Walter, a farmer living in the mountains, hides an undercover cop hunted by criminals. The arrival of his daughter, Daria unearths Walter's buried past. In the silence of the mountain, a brutal reckoning erupts, where redemption comes through fire and blood.

results.title: Wild Asia: Life at Extremes
results.overview: Atop the world’s tallest peaks of the Himalayas, get an intimate look at elusive Snow Leopards and Tiger moms in Nepal raising their young. Witness a Tibetan Fox ‘hide-and-seek hunting’ amongst yaks on an ancient plateau, catch glimpses of the secretive red panda in its remote forest stronghold, meet the remarkable long-eared jumping Jerboa in the harsh Gobi Desert, and fly alongside beautiful songbirds feeding on “sapcicles” in northern Japan. In the world’s richest coral seas of the Pacific, discover the cute-yet-deadly Sea Bunny and be immersed in an unbelievable shark feeding frenzy, that’s never been filmed before. Each story reveals the incredible ways in which wildlife has adapted to thrive in these challenging habitats.

results.title: Christina
results.overview: Four respected young men in a village face disruption and conflicts after a salesgirl's arrival.

results.title: Twin Stars
results.overview: The story, set in a rural place, tells in a comic way the difference between the slow pace of the province and the frenetic pace of the capital.

results.title: F. M. K.
results.overview: Some couples love food; other couples share a love of travel…while this couple has an insatiable love for murder. So, when a life of mundane normalcy interrupts their thrill, a couple of kooky killers falls out of love. Well, there’s only one thing that can bring them back together…the thing that connected them in the first place of course…

results.title: The Geography of Violence
results.overview: A culminating triptych/trilogy of three shorts , Siobhan, St Pancras Sunrise Short, The Wolf 30 minutes long exploring violence against women across all landscapes, rural, urban -institutional and the home. And women's responses, though structured around hope, it also dramatizes the epidemic of violence as a omnipresent force not  isolated incidents. It also shows tragedy, increasing strength of women and a gripping unbearable tension.

results.title: Seduction
results.overview: Paulo Martins, a soap opera actor at the peak of his career, believes he has achieved everything he ever wanted: fame, recognition, and money. While filming, he receives news of the death of his father, whom he hasn't seen in 30 years. This event forces him to return to the Amazon rainforest, to the banks of the Tapajós River, where he embarks on a deeply personal journey through memories, reunions, and old wounds that could forever transform his relationship with the past.

results.title: Эффект компассии
results.overview: Accountant Nina is passionate about writing a book about how good deeds can change lives for the better. The owner of the robotics company where Nina works is deciding to retire. To find a successor, he invents a game where each employee must perform as many good deeds as possible by a certain deadline. Nina remains true to herself, while her colleagues strive to win at any cost.

results.title: Landing Nowhere
results.overview: Two astronauts stranded on a deserted planet must decide between completing their mission - repopulating a new world artificially. Or preserve the planet's untouched beauty & let humanity fade away...

results.title: Leif GW om veckans fall
results.overview: Criminologist Leif GW Persson reviews and analyzes the week’s most high-profile criminal cases, delivering his trademark blunt and outspoken commentary.

results.title: Limelight
results.overview: Following an encounter with the Irish Mob, an Actor (Theo Creager) copes with his new life inside the Witness Protection Program.

results.title: Machado
results.overview: Julián films his relatives on his mother’s side, film and television actors in the 1990s, while trying to understand what happened to his mother, who’s been institutionalized in different psychiatric facilities for more than 25 years.
